'''Jeff McRae''' of Fulton, New York, was the first player to send the correct title for Puzzle 1 of the 1997 Dagobah Contest, [[What Is Thy Bidding, My Master?]]. He won a display box of white-border Premiere packs.<ref name="sol1">[http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution1.html The Dagobah Contest], Decipher (17 March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327214330/http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution1.html Internet Archive]</ref> He was also one of eleven finalists in Decipher's 1997 Design a Card contest, which [[Guy Kargl]] won with [[S-foils]].<ref name="win">[http://www.decipher.com/insidedecipher/archives/1997/designawinner.html Guy Kargl Wins Star Wars CCG Card Design Contest], Rich Loftus, Decipher (23 May 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990210055006/http://www.decipher.com/insidedecipher/archives/1997/designawinner.html Internet Archive]</ref>
